correctness.rationale: If equivalence relations E,F permute, their composition is their join. On each join-connected component every E-class intersects every F-class; conversely a complete array of positive cell cardinalities realizes commuting relations. Named relations forbid swapping row and column roles. Thus connected isomorphism classes correspond to strictly positive integral r-by-s matrices modulo S_r x S_s; general frames are unordered multisets of connected types. A product of row permutation cycle a and column cycle b has gcd(a,b) orbits of length lcm(a,b), yielding the stated weighted Burnside summand and formal B(z). The multiset construction yields U(z)=product_m(1-z^m)^(-b_m). For any coefficient n, rs<=n is exhaustive because cells are positive. I independently implemented exact rational cycle-index enumeration and the multiset transform through n=8, reproducing b=[0,1,3,5,10,14,27,36,64] and u=[1,1,4,9,25,54,136,294,684]. This bounded replay supports the all-n Burnside proof; no inference from finite data to all-n counts was made.

originality.rationale: Rumenova and Tinchev explicitly developed the complete nonempty cell-matrix representation of two commuting equivalence relations, which is credited. OEIS A354458 counts labelled relation pairs; these totals alone do not determine orbit counts. The new result is an all-n ordinary generating series counting *unlabelled* isomorphism types with ordered relation names and its initial coefficients. The materially read authors' slides establish the structural representation but not the weighted Burnside isomorphism-class generating function. Their full journal paper remained inaccessible, leaving a prior exact-count risk; no exact series was located in tested aliases and searches, which alone is not novelty proof.

value.rationale: An exact complete isomorphism-class enumeration for all finite cardinalities in a natural two-modal S5 commuting-frame class has independent combinatorial and modal-model value. The weighted positive-matrix Burnside series solves the natural distinction between labelled relational structures and unlabelled frames, and gives reproducible exact coefficients rather than ad hoc isolated instances.

limitations: Full Rumenova–Tinchev 2022 published journal article unavailable; possible unindexed explicit orbit count therein.

Named relations cannot be swapped; quotienting by an additional transpose symmetry would change counts.
